newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 105,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 105,000 - USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa/southern Minnesota hog receipts Friday were 105,000 head, compared with 102,000 a week ago and 90,000 a week ago.

Saturday's estimate was 15,000 head, compared with 14,000 a week ago and 8,000 a year ago. Estimates include generally about 65 percent carcass base hogs. Barrows and gilts were $1.00 per cwt lower than the midsession Thursday. Trade moderate for light demand and light to moderate offerings.

Compared to last week: Barrows and Gilts 3.00 lower. Sows 1.00-3.00 lower. Receipts this week 462,000 last week 499,000, last year 411,000. Barrows and Gilts average weight for week ending May 24, 1997 253.2 lbs compared to 254.4 lbs previous week 247.7 lbs last year.
